text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, training was off, so taking the 
opportunity, I was eagerly plowing through 
work when...
choice_data_list: Ow, ow... My neck feels a little stiff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack crack crack)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a loud noise...! T-Trainer, 
thanks for your hard work.
choice_data_list: Oh, Miracle! But today's your day off...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true, but... There's something 
I'd like to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For now... why don't you take a breather? 
Oh, I can help you stretch, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Could we talk after that, if you don't 
mind? ...I want to plan our hot springs 
trip together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! And so, you ended up deciding to go 
this coming weekend, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring, must be nice... Please go 
enjoy getting completely refreshed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks for giving me so much advice, 
Nature.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You knew so much about the hot springs we 
visited; it was a huge help."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it just sort of grew out of my 
hobby, so to speak. I'm glad if I could be 
of help.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... was that really okay? The place 
I recommended was, well...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty much geared toward people 
relaxing on their own, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Most of them weren't really places a pair 
could enjoy together, but—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what I wanted to hear, so 
it's fine. ...Thanks, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, over the weekend... I went on the 
hot spring trip I won in the raffle, 
together with K.S. Miracle!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Both the inn's room and the nearby hot 
spring town had such a wonderful 
atmosphere, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow, even the atmosphere in the air 
feels so laid-back..."
choice_data_list:
Looks like you can really unwind and relax 
here.

Looks like you'll be able to truly unwind 
here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, by the way... I believe the plan was 
that we'd have free time once we put our 
luggage down.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I asked a friend who knows a lot for some 
recommendations. ...I'll send them to you 
on LANE now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A message arrives from K.S.Miracle. 
Checking it, I find links to historic 
garden tours and traditional Japanese cafe 
recommendations—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every single spot looked like a great 
place to relax. Just looking at the photos 
in the guide feels strangely soothing...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Did you find any places you might like, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Where would you like to go first?
Yeah! Where do you want to go first?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... um. There's somewhere I'd like to go 
by myself for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly apologized. For some reason, I 
had just assumed we'd be going together, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being around me, their instructor, 
wouldn't allow for proper rest in the 
first place. I reflected on my lack of 
consideration.
choice_data_list:
Just make sure you don't stay out too 
late.

Just make sure you don't stay out too 
late, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Um—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please... take all the time you 
need to relax, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I took it easy and relaxed for a 
while at the traditional folk-house café 
that was recommended to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things have been quite hectic these past 
three years or so, so feeling all that 
deep-seated fatigue unwind feels 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While basking in that fluffy, happy 
feeling... My eyes suddenly catch the 
souvenir section set up in front of the 
register.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer... I wonder if you're getting 
enough rest?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I was worried it might look like I 
suddenly pushed her away, so I wondered 
what to do... I even considered staying 
with her to show her around, but...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever we're together, for some 
reason... no matter what...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"This place seems like it would truly 
heal you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"This place seems like it would truly 
heal you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"Ah! Where would you like to go first?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"Yeah! Where would you like to go first?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're always only ever thinking about 
me... Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that's not good. It's 
definitely... not good.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(No matter what, the time I have left is 
short.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even without that, I've... I've received 
far too much from that person over these 
past three years.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(So much already... There's no way I could 
ever repay it all.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (And yet, beyond this is—...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please... don't be so hung up on me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer. You're back.
choice_data_list:
Ah, welcome back. Did you check out the 
hot springs?

Yeah, I'm back. Did you go to the hot 
springs?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just a moment ago. The water was 
wonderful, so... you should definitely try 
it too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? That package... Did you buy some 
kind of souvenir?
choice_data_list: Oh right, here— this is for you
Oh right, here— this is for you

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While talking about how wonderful the 
renovated traditional cafe was, I briskly 
take out the bag.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had heard before that K.S.Miracle isn't 
fond of the cold, so—
choice_data_list:
I figured you'd like the design of these 
knit gloves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not... a swan, but rather a bluebird 
patch— matching her racing silks' color— 
neatly sewn onto it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in the souvenir corner of a 
traditional cafe and bought it almost on 
pure impulse. I hope she likes it...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry, did you not like it that much?
Ah, sorry, was it not to your liking?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: !! Ah... N-No.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. ...Um... I'll take good 
care of it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I got a little too warm, so... I'm going 
to take a walk outside, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......Well, this is troublesome.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I don't want you to be held back by me, 
...and I need to be ready to let go of 
your hand whenever the time comes, but...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I should be able to do that anytime, 
though...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you've really got me. Letting go, 
I mean—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...We're gonna have to work pretty darn 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with K.S.Miracle...
